description: For one Twin Cities home: this year's county value, last year's, the change between them, what recorded sales of similar homes say, how the ZIP's sale prices moved, and whether the county tends to over-assess that area. Use for 'my assessment went up 15%, is that normal', 'why did my property value go up so much', 'my house was reassessed higher'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis. Pass the street address with its city or ZIP, and the new value from the owner's notice if they have one.

address.description: Street address with city or ZIP

value_on_notice.description: Optional: the estimated market value on the owner's newest valuation notice

name: property_assessment_increase
title: My property assessment went up. Is the increase fair? (Twin Cities, Minnesota)
